consent_records_actor_check.name: consent_records_actor_check
consent_records_actor_check.value: ("consent_records"."user_id" is not null or "consent_records"."anonymous_id" is not null)

advisories_severity_matches_cvss.name: advisories_severity_matches_cvss
advisories_severity_matches_cvss.value:
(
  advisories.cvss IS NULL
  OR advisories.severity IS NULL
  OR (advisories.severity = 'critical' AND advisories.cvss BETWEEN 9.0 AND 10.0)
  OR (advisories.severity = 'high'     AND advisories.cvss BETWEEN 7.0 AND 8.9)
  OR (advisories.severity = 'medium'   AND advisories.cvss BETWEEN 4.0 AND 6.9)
  OR (advisories.severity = 'low'      AND advisories.cvss BETWEEN 0.1 AND 3.9)
)

onboarding_profiles_min_age.name: onboarding_profiles_min_age
onboarding_profiles_min_age.value: "onboarding_profiles"."date_of_birth" IS NULL OR "onboarding_profiles"."date_of_birth" <= current_date - interval '16 years'
